page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 storage-oriented instance featuring 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Utilizing KVM hypervisor technology with dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides 32.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per vCPU), a bundled 959 GB local SSD volume, and a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation. The CPU architecture supports instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AES cryptography, and FMA.

Benchmark evaluations highlight balanced throughput for database operations alongside moderate compute capabilities. The system achieves a PassMark CPU score of 6917.37 and extended instruction performance of 5854.7, falling into average reference bands. Memory bandwidth tests yield an uncached write rate of 35.92 GB/sec. In key-value cache benchmarks, the server handles 6.1 million Redis SET operations per second, while small-model LLM inference prompt processing achieves 444.45 tokens per second.

The integration of 959 GB local SSD storage eliminates external block storage overhead, delivering resource density for I/O-intensive tasks. However, single-threaded performance is lower relative to modern processors, with single-core compression benchmarks placing in lower percentiles. The overall hardware profile suits local transactional databases, key-value caches like Redis, static web hosting, and small-parameter AI model inference.
